Ethan: kicking off canary for paladin11b-int4 on pool-33. seeing OOMs on long summarization runs and a small summary-quality dip (~1.6 ROUGE). node log: `kv_cache_alloc failed`
Mina: runtime flags? prefetch/batch_window/microbatch/max_new_tokens/slot_reserve?
Ethan: defaults: prefetch=true, continuous_batching=true, microbatch=6, slot_reserve=0.04, max_new_tokens=320. repro is long-doc -> ~1k tokens; failures ~600-800 tokens.
Carlos: paste allocator snippet if you have it, but my money is on fragmentation (slot_frag high) not raw peak.
Ethan: node excerpt:
```
ERROR OOM kv_alloc
used=12.0GB free=0.5GB slot_frag=0.27
freelist_scan=8 compact_ops=0
```
Mina: slot_frag 0.27 is worrying. quick, low-risk experiments: A) prefetch=false + cap max_new_tokens=160; B) keep prefetch but enable `compact_on_evict=true` and bump `slot_compactor_threshold` to 0.15; C) reduce concurrency `max_parallel_requests=2`. which first?
Ethan: trying A now: `curl -X POST https://canary/api/serve -d '{"model":"paladin11b-int4","opts":{"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":160}}'` (job 5278901242)
ops-bot: Canary deploy started for paladin11b-int4 on pool-33 (job 5278901242)
Carlos: also kick off a small A/B (400 prompts) int4 vs int8 and hybrid-int8-attn (int8 for attn/kv) to check if quantization is the quality culprit.
Mina: if hybrid recovers quality, we should try per-channel scale calibration for q/k/v layers before defaulting to hybrid.
Ethan: update: after ~1.5k inferences with prefetch off + max_new_tokens=160 -> zero OOMs. p50 +11ms, cost +6.2%. starting int8/hybrid AB (job 5278901249).
Carlos: nice. propose rollout: keep paladin11b default int4 but conservative defaults for 48h: `prefetch=false`, `max_new_tokens=160`, `max_parallel_requests=2`. monitor slot_frag, OOM_rate, and eval quality.
Mina: add auto gates: rollback if OOM_rate > 0.05% or ROUGE drops >1.2 pts on the summarization eval. also log `nvidia-smi` and allocator traces on any OOM.
Carlos: medium-term: enable `compact_on_evict=true` and a nightly background `freelist_defrag` sweep during off-peak, then slowly restore prefetch once slot_frag trends down. consider `kv_prealloc_window=64` for long-gen workloads to reduce alloc churn.
Ethan: will add alerts + the rollout checklist. if hybrid AB shows ~0.3-0.7 pts recovery, test per-channel recalibration next. will post AB numbers in the morning. thanks :thumbsup:
